---

**Why this matters:**
The Yanso calendar engine currently uses an unverified anchor date.
Even a single confirmed Gregorian ↔ Nso weekday pairing allows the weekday
cycle to be locked in for all other dates. Three or more pairings
spanning different years would also help verify the month/year alignment.
See `docs/research/open_questions.md` for the full picture.
